eyebrow: On-policy: learns the policy it actually follows
code:
SARSA:
Q(S_t,A_t) ← Q(S_t,A_t) + α[
  R_t+1 + γQ(S_t+1, A_t+1) − Q(S_t,A_t)
]  # A_t+1 is the action actually taken
caption: SARSA plugs in the action the agent's own behavior policy actually chose.

eyebrow: Off-policy: learns about the greedy target policy
code:
Q-learning:
Q(S_t,A_t) ← Q(S_t,A_t) + α[
  R_t+1 + γ max_a Q(S_t+1,a) − Q(S_t,A_t)
]  # max over a, not the action actually taken
caption: Q-learning bootstraps off the best possible next action, not the one actually taken.
